verdict.summary: Round 4 remains correct and complete as an analysis-only change. The six-condition BAF statement excludes the identified variable-predicate and recursive compound-term counterexamples, and its finite active-domain/ground-head argument supports the stated termination and PTIME data-complexity bounds. The record carefully limits those bounds to checked fragment membership, distinguishes termination from OSB evaluation cost, scopes arbitrary-rule nontermination to current in-process callers, and explicitly marks ACP/ODRL as unaudited. It also labels the argument informal rather than machine-checked, makes clear enforcement is not shipped, and preserves the required ZK/MPC and non-canonical-performance caveats. The proposed rejection cases are concrete, non-vacuous future checker tests, and the companion design accurately carries the analysis and limitations. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue is present. With no findings in rounds 3 or 4, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
